title: Fall back to getMetaspacePointer() in JfrEventSubstitution

timeline.body: If accepted, we would like to get this into the 21.2 release branch. Thanks!
@christianhaeubl Hi! Could you please take a look at this simple fix and tell whether this would be acceptable. It should do no harm. Thank you!

`getMetaspacePointer` should work on all JDK versions, so please adapt that code so that it always uses `getMetaspacePointer` (i.e., remove `method.getDeclaredMethod("getMetaspaceMethod");`). This will also make the comment that you added obsolete.
